description_en: Invoke the ResetHotlineNumber API to reset the inbound (IVR flow) and outbound (effective scope) configuration information of a hotline number
description_zh: 调用ResetHotlineNumber接口重置热线号码的呼入（IVR流程）、呼出（生效范围）配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs reset-hotline-number --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --hotline-number 057100000000 --description '热线号码' --enable-inbound true --inbound-flow-id 123456 --enable-outbound true --outbound-all-depart true --enable-inbound-evaluation true --enable-outbound-evaluation true --evaluation-level 2 --outbound-range-list '[{"GroupIdList":[123456],"DepartmentId":123456}]' --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetHotlineNumber
